en.seoTitle: The team & your contacts | Nordic RentAway Spain
en.seoDescription: Meet your contacts at Nordic RentAway Spain. Speak to Johan Sjölin about your Costa Blanca property, or reach the guest experience team.
en.heading:
Local people.
Personal hospitality.
en.intro: We are Nordic RentAway Spain, an international team looking after holiday homes and their guests on the Costa Blanca.
en.body: We bring together rental management, property care, interiors and local advice. Our work connects the people who own a home here with the people who come to enjoy it.
en.contactsText: For your property, speak to Johan or Isabel. For a holiday or an existing reservation, our Guest Experience Team can help.
en.localHeading: Come for the coast. Get to know the place.
en.localText: The team also shares a local guide to places, food and activities on the Costa Blanca through We Recommend.
